{"notes": "VISIT 4 (left at 8:30). Table: fish still complete and connected from nose to both tail tips (top curls to ~(27.5,4.5), bottom to ~(28,15.5)). Doubled/tight dominoes at x=16.5-18 and x=20-21 remain, possible fragile joins. Pale stray near (15,6) still unconnected, unclaimed; it won't fall with the fish. No hands visible on the table, so team was hands-off. Fall is still untested. I still don't know who placed which domino, so build credit stays shared.

Maya: At 8:00 gave the two-minute call, said 'we're set, hands off.' Consistent leadership tone through the end, keeping people from last-minute tinkering. Still based on what I heard, not on seeing her build. Ask what she placed, how she ran handoffs, and whether she knew about the stray.

Tom: At 8:15 backed the hands-off call. Supportive, but adds little new. Earlier accurate status report shows attention. Ask what he built and whether the stray is his.

Priya: Silent this visit. No new evidence. Earlier: backed hands-off plan, considerate. Top arm is clean but I can't confirm she placed it. Ask her.

Leo: Silent again, no new evidence. Visit 1 offer to take far ends may explain the tail, but unseen, so no credit yet. Ask what he placed, who joined sections, and about the stray.

Provisional: strong team result, no one stands out or lags on my evidence. Keep scores near the middle until review conversations; watch how the fall goes, especially at the doubled joins."}
